row.notes: Writes into the vec4 array at inst+0xb0 (16 bytes per slot, slot = index). mask 0xf: bounds check index+count <= byte +0xd8, compare then copy count whole vec4s. Other masks: only the components whose bit (1,2,4,8) is set are taken, packed in order from values, and written if different; when +0xc0 is set and +0x13c bit 0x10, the write is repeated over [[inst+0xd0]+0x48] u16 copies in the array at +0xb8 with stride byte +0xd8. On any change sets +0x128 state to 2 (scheduling job 0x143d3f3f0 through 0x146c641e0 vt+0x68 when it was 0) and +0x12c bit 8. Callers: Ui_LayoutTree_Walk writes per-node shader values (indices and masks cached in globals 0x146ca6df8..0x146ca6ee0) on [node+0x180]+0x60; 0x1442fb9e0 forwards a stored param record (index +0x20, mask +0x24) and uses Ne_ModelInstance_SetNodeMatrices on the same object for mask 0xf; 0x144305250 pushes element values to [elem+0x180]+0x60. Context from caller: the object looks like a Ne model instance material parameter block. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
